record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare TWISTER: Dratini (1 star), Dragonair (2 stars), Dragonite (3 stars); all range 1, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are only the star count. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Area around the caster. Every enemy on one of the 8 cells adjacent to the caster takes SPECIAL damage (raw 25/50/100 by stars) and is then displaced by a swap to a randomly chosen empty cell, within a radius of 1/2/3 cells of the enemy's own cell, that is farthest (Manhattan distance) from the caster. Adjacent allies that have an active FLYING synergy effect (other than the caster) fly away instead (no damage). The cast target itself is not used except for the animation and gate.

targeting.who: every unit on the up to 8 adjacent cells of the caster at the time of the cast: enemies are damaged and displaced; allies other than the caster with a FLYING synergy effect call flyAway; other allies and empty cells are ignored
targeting.note: The cell list is snapshotted once before any damage or move; each snapshot entity is processed once even if an earlier displacement changed the board, but the empty-cell search for each enemy reads the live board, so cells already taken by earlier-moved enemies are excluded. The cast target is only passed to the base process. A target adjacent to the caster is hit like any other; a target farther away (range 1 units attack adjacent ones) is not hit by the strategy.

geometry.shape: 3x3 block centred on the caster (8 cells), clipped to the board; displacement search disc of radius flyRange (floor(r)+0.5, strictly inside) around each hit enemy

effects.target: each enemy on an adjacent cell
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Damage is dealt before the displacement and independently of whether the displacement happens; a target with protect still can be displaced (protect is not checked by moveTo).

effects.target: each enemy that was on an adjacent cell
effects.scaling: radius = flyRange from the table; getCellsInRadius uses floor(|radius|) + 0.5 and a strict squared-distance test, with the enemy's own cell excluded. No AP or crit scaling.
effects.resolution: candidates = empty cells (live board) in that disc; distance of each candidate is measured from the CASTER's cell, not from the enemy; those at the maximum Manhattan distance are kept and one is picked uniformly (pickRandomIn). The enemy is then moved with moveTo(..., forcedDisplacement = true), a cell swap, which does nothing if the enemy canBeMoved is false (skydiving, locked or Heavy-Duty Boots). If there is no empty cell (maxDistance -Infinity, empty list) pickRandomIn returns undefined and the enemy stays. The destination can be nearer to or on the same side as the caster, since only the farthest within the disc is chosen; with radius 1 around a unit adjacent to a caster it may not increase the distance.

effects.target: each adjacent ally (not the caster) with an active FLYING synergy effect

declaredRaw.label: no numeric amount in this strategy

effects.resolution: calls flyAway(board) with its defaults: the ally moves to the cell chosen by Board.getFlyAwayCell (with a fallback), and Feather Dance / Skydive / Max Airstream holders also get protect or a skydive attack. This is delegated behaviour; only the entry points were read.

starBehavior.note: Damage and radius are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (200 damage, radius 6, also the ?? fallbacks) are not reachable by the bare factory star counts. The targeting block (8 adjacent cells) does not change with stars.

record.positionalConditions: Entirely positional: which units are hit depends on the 8 neighbours of the caster; the destination depends on empty cells within the radius and their Manhattan distance from the caster, so edges, corners and crowding limit or remove the displacement.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes everything from the current board.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: raw SPECIAL damage 25/50/100 (1/2/3 stars) to each adjacent enemy and displacement within radius 1/2/3. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then special-defence division and a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied displacement may be absent (no empty cell, unit cannot be moved) and is not guaranteed to move the unit away from the caster in an absolute sense.
